verdict.rationale: Push-based sign-in with phishing defenses is a fair question for an identity and credential security product like 1Password, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has nothing on push approvals, number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies. The only related items are device-trust messaging and system-authentication unlock (Touch ID/Windows Hello), which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
